//! surgical_target.rs — clean, idiomatic Rust matching the Axiom repo's design
//! patterns: Result-based error handling, small focused functions, immutable
//! data flow, doc comments, and a thin typed wrapper over a candle tensor.

use std::collections::HashMap;

use candle_core::{DType, Device, Result, Tensor};

/// A per-layer fast-weight matrix paired with its layer index.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct LayerState {
    pub index: usize,
    pub weight: Tensor,
}

impl LayerState {
    /// Build an identity-initialised state of shape `[d_model, d_model]`.
    pub fn identity(index: usize, d_model: usize, device: &Device) -> Result<Self> {
        let weight = Tensor::eye(d_model, DType::F32, device)?;
        Ok(Self { index, weight })
    }

    /// Frobenius norm of the underlying weight matrix.
    pub fn frobenius_norm(&self) -> Result<f32> {
        let squared = self.weight.sqr()?.sum_all()?;
        Ok(squared.to_scalar::<f32>()?.sqrt())
    }
}

/// Exponential moving average of two states: `keep * a + (1 - keep) * b`.
pub fn ema_merge(a: &Tensor, b: &Tensor, keep: f64) -> Result<Tensor> {
    let left = a.affine(keep, 0.0)?;
    let right = b.affine(1.0 - keep, 0.0)?;
    left.add(&right)
}

/// Summarise a stack of layer states into a name->norm map.
pub fn summarise(states: &[LayerState]) -> Result<HashMap<String, f32>> {
    let mut out = HashMap::with_capacity(states.len());
    for state in states {
        out.insert(format!("layer_{}", state.index), state.frobenius_norm()?);
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// Count the states whose norm exceeds a threshold, using an iterator chain.
pub fn count_active(states: &[LayerState], threshold: f32) -> Result<usize> {
    let mut active = 0;
    for state in states {
        if state.frobenius_norm()? > threshold {
            active += 1;
        }
    }
    Ok(active)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn device() -> Device {
        Device::Cpu
    }

    #[test]
    fn identity_has_expected_shape() {
        let state = LayerState::identity(0, 8, &device()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(state.weight.dims(), &[8, 8]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn ema_blends_toward_second() {
        let dev = device();
        let a = Tensor::eye(4, DType::F32, &dev).unwrap();
        let b = a.affine(2.0, 0.0).unwrap();
        let merged = ema_merge(&a, &b, 0.9).unwrap();
        let diag = merged.flatten_all().unwrap().to_vec1::<f32>().unwrap();
        assert!((diag[0] - 1.1).abs() < 1e-5);
    }

    #[test]
    fn summary_contains_every_layer() {
        let dev = device();
        let states: Vec<LayerState> = (0..3)
            .map(|i| LayerState::identity(i, 4, &dev).unwrap())
            .collect();
        let summary = summarise(&states).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(summary.len(), 3);
    }
}
